content.text: {"id": "mm4901a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The overall NTD rate in the border counties for 1993-1998 was 13.4 per 10,000 live births"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The rate among Hispanics was 13.8 per 10,000 live births and the rate among non-Hispanic whites was 8.8 (p=0.08)."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The surveillance system identified 360 resident NTD-affected births/terminations (cases)"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of 65 (34%) eligible women with induced abortions, 22 (34%) refused participation in the folic acid intervention"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The overall NTD rate in the border counties for 1993-1998 was 13.4 per 10,000 live births"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "El Paso County (the northwesternmost county) had a significantly lower NTD rate (9.0) than the rest of the border counties combined"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Of 65 (34%) eligible women with induced abortions, 22 (34%) refused participation in the folic acid intervention"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The rate among Hispanics also was significantly lower for El Paso County (8.8) than that for the rest of the border counties (16.1)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The TNTDP surveillance system involved prospective case finding"}]}, {"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "folic acid appears to be effective for reducing the risk for NTD recurrence in Hispanics."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Denominator data (live birth, death, and fetal death records) were derived from the Bureau of Vital Statistics at TDH"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "(95% CI**)"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth", "study_design"]}
